players.product: Optical fiber made from in-house preform and optical cable, incl. reduced-coating fiber for high-density / micro cables and multimode fiber for high-capacity data links

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, consolidated): H1 revenue KRW 83,302,305,556 (H1 2025: KRW 67,031,793,834); Q2 revenue KRW 49,053,665,495 (Q2 2025: KRW 41,638,182,684). Q2 operating profit KRW 956,781,924 (Q2 2025: operating loss KRW 2,773,349,398); H1 operating loss KRW 3,004,622,192 (H1 2025: loss KRW 9,693,767,742); H1 net loss KRW 3,227,294,213 (H1 2025: KRW 8,115,797,890). H1 revenue by business (KRW million): telecom (optical cable etc.) 47,731 (57%; export 36,670, domestic 11,061), power (OPGW etc.) 35,571 (43%). Overseas revenue KRW 53,671,302 thousand vs KRW 38,860,627 thousand in H1 2025; Korea KRW 29,631,004 thousand.

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog at the end of H1 2026 (KRW million): telecom orders 143,094, delivered 29,021, backlog 114,073; power orders 15,635, delivered 2,766, backlog 12,869; total backlog 126,942.
quarterly_data.figure: Order backlog KRW 126,942 million (telecom KRW 114,073 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and output in H1 2026 (cost-of-production basis, KRW million): Taihan Fiberoptics telecom (optical cable etc., Ansan and Yesan) capacity 36,688, production 31,185; power (OPGW etc., Yesan) capacity 10,812, production 7,568; TFO Networks aluminium (AL rod etc.) capacity 42,653, production 29,857; INCAB America (Grapevine, TX; two months) telecom capacity 3,951, production 2,372, power capacity 11,925, production 4,638. Group capacity 106,029 vs production 75,620. No new facility or purchase plan.
quarterly_data.figure: Telecom capacity KRW 36,688 million, production KRW 31,185 million; group production KRW 75,620 million of KRW 106,029 million capacity

quarterly_data.signal: On 2026-04-30 the group acquired 90% of INCAB America LLC, a US optical and power cable maker in Grapevine, Texas, to expand optical cable manufacturing and sales in the US; INCAB America contributed KRW 6,144,290 thousand of H1 revenue. The company describes itself as Korea's only integrated maker from fiber preform through optical fiber to optical cable. The report flags a material uncertainty over going concern: the company cites large losses and financial difficulty from a multi-year Chinese optical fiber oversupply and is responding with the US cable acquisition and a US-centred sales base, restructuring of low-margin businesses, total cost reduction and maturity extensions of bank borrowings.
quarterly_data.figure: 90% of INCAB America LLC acquired 2026-04-30; INCAB America H1 revenue KRW 6,144,290 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Product development listed in the report: telecom fibers incl. zero-water-peak fiber, bend-insensitive G.657.A1/A2/B3 fiber, NZ-DSF long-haul fiber, Anywave-LL ultra-low-loss fiber for submarine cable, Anywave 200 reduced-coating fiber for small-diameter, high-fiber-count and micro cables, and multimode fiber for high-capacity data transmission; specialty fibers (Yb-, ErYb- and Tm-doped gain fiber, PM fiber) and fiber laser modules and systems up to 20kW; and synthetic quartz ingot for optical and semiconductor parts. H1 R&D spending KRW 2,220,465 thousand (6.5% of revenue).

Taihan Fiberoptics.why: Integrated maker of optical fiber preform, optical fiber and optical cable (incl. reduced-coating fiber for high-density cables and multimode fiber for data links); telecom optical cable is 57% of revenue, so fiber demand from network build-outs drives its sales.
Taihan Fiberoptics.evidence: Taihan Fiberoptics Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026) half-year report: Korea's only integrated fiber-to-cable producer making optical fiber from its own core preform through finished optical cable; telecom (optical cable) revenue KRW 47,731 million (57%) in H1 2026.
